more_info.overview: Sodium hydroxide is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include edible caseinates, milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products, other similar fruit or vegetable spreads. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
